description: Repository rules and constraints for sdp-trace subagents

sections.title: Trust Rules
sections.content: Machine proof wins over prose. No deferred trust closure. Source-bound proof requires clean immutable source commit. No TODO/FIXME markers in new Go code.

sections.title: Technology Stack
sections.content: Go is target product code. No Node.js/TS/JS in active product path. Bash only as thin command launcher. Keep root router under 100 lines.

sections.title: Quality Gates
sections.content: Cyclomatic complexity <= 10. Cognitive complexity <= 10. CRAP < 5 strict. File MI baseline ratchet 70. Function MI baseline ratchet 70.

sections.title: Verification Commands
sections.content: go test -count=1 ./... -coverprofile; go tool cover -func; go run ./tools/qualitycheck -fail-only -cyclo-over 10 -cognitive-over 10 cmd internal tools; go run ./tools/qualitycheck -fail-only -function-mi-under 70 -function-mi-baseline tools/qualitycheck/function-mi-baseline.json cmd internal; go run ./tools/qualitycheck -fail-only -mi-under 70 -mi-baseline tools/qualitycheck/file-mi-baseline.json cmd internal tools; go run ./tools/qualitycheck -gocyclo > gocyclo.txt; go run ./tools/crapcheck -cover-func coverage-func.txt -gocyclo gocyclo.txt -threshold 5 -strict-less; go vet ./...; go run ./tools/doccheck; git diff --check

sections.title: Model Policy
sections.content: For adversarial review, prefer non-OpenAI, non-Anthropic, and non-Google models unless explicitly permitted otherwise.

sections.title: Current Strategy
sections.content: Family-prefixed files within existing flat package main. No subpackages. Behavior lock via command-surface JSON and --help snapshots.
